title: Nix Just Bought the Entire School 🍟
topic: The resolution of the midnight delivery empire

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I didn’t just deliver chips at midnight [beat] I built a snacking empire right under your noses while the whole world slept!

lines.speaker: choto
lines.text: Every single delivery truck on this block belongs to a teenager [beat] and Nix is the one signing my paychecks every Friday!

lines.speaker: sam
lines.text: He wasn't just sneaking out to ride his scooter [beat] he was mapping out every hungry customer in a three-block radius!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: I wanted to expel him for the midnight rule-breaking [beat] but then he showed me he actually owns the land the school is built on!

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: Now I have to wear this embarrassing pink uniform [beat] and deliver spicy wings to the kids I used to shove into lockers!

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: I thought my son was out getting into trouble [beat] but then he paid off our entire mortgage with a mountain of delivery tips!

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: My boy isn't a delinquent [beat] he’s a logistical mastermind who turned a rusty scooter into a massive fleet of delivery drones!

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: He even hired me to code the ordering app [beat] though he still won't give me a discount on the extra-large Flamin' Hot bags!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: The secret was simple [beat] people get the most hungry when the shops are closed and my prices are at their absolute highest!

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: I offered him a million dollars to buy the whole brand [beat] but Nix told me he doesn't take investments from amateurs anymore!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: He even replaced the water fountains with soda dispensers [beat] and honestly the school budget has never looked better than this!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And that is how a midnight craving [beat] turned into a snack dynasty that ruled the streets and everyone’s stomach.
